verdict.rationale: Jitsu lets you control where data lives in two documented ways: self-hosting on any on-premise or your own Kubernetes infrastructure, and delivering events into the warehouse you choose rather than storing them in a vendor store. However, the evidence documents no region or residency selector for Jitsu Cloud and makes no explicit data-residency guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented region choice for the hosted cloud, explicit residency or data-location commitments, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Jitsu is 100% open-source and can be deployed to any on-premise infrastructure.
Run Jitsu yourself on Kubernetes with Helm, fully under your control.
You want the option to run the pipe on your own infrastructure, which Segment does not offer at any price.
Make your data warehouse the single source of truth for your data.
Delivery to destinations — ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3, GCS, and dozens of SaaS tools
